scoring_justification: Headline ΔH/ΔS are derived by baseline-subtracted integration; the agent's internal baseline and integration algorithm cannot be recomputed from the final CSV alone. Therefore comparing the reported values against the paper's published reference (Table III) with defined tolerances is the appropriate verifier strategy.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference enthalpy and entropy increments for each compound and peak from the paper
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table III: 'Enthalpy and Entropy Increments for the λ-Type Transitions in Li_xWO_3'
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct extraction of the reported central values (without uncertainties) from the published table.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact paper-reported quantities that define the reproduction target; they ground the verification against the original publication.

schema.description: Seven rows total: exactly three for Li0.363WO3 (peak_number 1,2,3), two each for Li0.437WO3 and Li0.478WO3 (peak_number 1,2).

outputs.description: Transition enthalpy and entropy increments for each λ-type anomaly, computed by baseline-subtracted integration. The checker compares delta_H and delta_S to hidden reference values (paper Table III) with appropriate tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The baseline determination step is internal; only the final transition results are scored. The hidden gold values are the paper-reported ΔH and ΔS from Table III. Tolerance margins are set to absorb typical integration and baseline-choice variation.
